hypothesis: A synchronous capitulation across crypto perpetuals followed by a broad recovery can offer a directional trade in benchmark coins, even when neither benchmark prints an individual V1.7 wick. Reverse the construction for an upside squeeze that then fails.
universe: Use the 291 original OKX tapes plus the 69 independently documented retired names from exp-cloud-close-okx-directory-account-20261109-v1. Use only prices/regime membership seen by each UTC12H boundary. Require at least 30 concurrent instruments with a complete NY Monday range; all breadth denominators and reclaim counts are audited. BTC/ETH are the only trade instruments. This remains a historically incomplete exchange universe.
entry: On one completed 12H at least one third of observable contracts close beyond the same original Monday 1.618 outer band. On the immediately following completed 12H require at least half of the original breached names to close back inside their own completed-week bands. Require the original Monday to precede both keys and the same NY week. Retain only the first qualifying recovery per week, skip simultaneous opposing recoveries. Execute both BTC/ETH at the coincident opening immediately following recovery confirmation. Do not require BTC or ETH to emit a single-coin cloud signal.
exit: Hold equal raw notional of BTC/ETH, one group at a time, for at most 6 calendar days. At a completed 12H stop both if the equal-weight direction-adjusted simple return from actual cost-basis raw entry prices is at or below -5%; execute at the next coincident H1 open. Reset normal exits and controls per portfolio. Calendar timeout shortened only for sample end or marked gap in native prices.
comparison: For the same fixed breadth-shock clocks and the same original weekly-side opportunity select an alternative confirmed 12H exactly one bar later in the same NY week if available. Report paired-primary and delayed controls on this common eligible set. Shared 1000U cash, combined opening gross about 1x equity. 5bp charged per market fill on each native leg. Primary + adverse5bp slippage on top. Funding excluded. Preserve split at 2025 and 2026, report real monetary wins and losses.
